crossRefs.note: Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves.
Behold, you are beautiful, my love. Behold, you are beautiful. Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair is…
There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to…

translations.web: His eyes are like doves beside the water brooks, washed with milk, mounted like jewels.
translations.bsb: His eyes are like doves beside the streams of water, bathed in milk and mounted like jewels.
translations.kjv: His eyes are as the eyes of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, and fitly set.
translations.asv: His eyes are like doves beside the water-brooks, Washed with milk, and fitly set.
